job.title: Electronic Engineer
job.description:
Responsibility:

  • Responsible for the circuit module and system design of personal care products
  •  Responsible for feasibility analysis and evaluation of product electronic design
  •  Responsible for schematic design and wiring; and verify and debug
  • Presided over the analysis of development and trial production problems, put forward solutions and verify
  •  Leading OEM/ODM projects
  • Responsible for continuous quality improvement and provide cost optimization solutions
  • Report the progress of the project, and provide technical advice as the basis for decision-making by the project team or the upper level. Own the analysis and resolution of technical issues/problems, and actively cooperate with other functional departments to reach consensus on action. Ensure the completion of the project schedule. Ensure design compliance and respect for intellectual property


Qualification:

  • Master or PhD in electronic engineering, or undergraduate applicants with strong technical background
  • Strong practical and experimental ability in analog and digital circuit design and wiring
  • Good understanding about the electronics testing & manufacture process
  • Rich experience in the design of home appliances or consumer electronics
  • Proficient in spoken and written English at work
